author: Kami1252
quote: This would’ve been a perfectly good game has the GTA title not been attached. That being said this is not GTA. It essentially punishes you for trying to play the game like previous GTAs. This is not **** RDR there is 0 point to an honor system nor should we be forced to deal with an insufferable women like Lucia the entire game (whether you chose to follow the relationship or not)  Jason as a main character is comically bland and his voice sounds like what women think men sound like. After rockstar took 13 years to create this game and is mind bogglingly disappointing that we got this slop. Not to mention protecting certain groups of people from harm that **** is the opposite of what GTA was made for.
